scope: Source-only G4 evidence; no tracking or MVE outputs are admissible.

sources.observed_fact: The official README describes the MDMT task as associating identities of objects from different drones and defines MDA as the cross-view association evaluation task.
The official MDA evaluator forms cross-view ground-truth association pairs only when the two GT target IDs are equal.

FACT: The official task description declares cross-view identity association.
The official MDA evaluator uses equal GT IDs across the two views when constructing ground-truth association pairs.
INFERENCE: For this official MDA protocol, IDs participating in equal-ID cross-view pairs are not merely independent per-view labels.
